name: Noble/Commoner
description: A scion of a prestigious house given authority over the people./A member of Dagd's common folk, who hail from diverse backgrounds and positions.

name: Gladiator
description: Can deal devastating damage with weapons such as swords, axes, and gauntlets.

name: Hunter
description: Adept with both swords and bows. Draws upon dexterity and speed to stalk foes.

name: Soldier
description: A spear-wielder who dons armor and hold a shield for maximal defense.

name: Ornius Rider
description: Mounted upon an ornius, this class can leap over obstacles.

name: Diviner
description: Uses magic to both heal allies and harm foes.

name: Myrmidon
description: A sword specialist who metes out swift strikes to foes.

name: Brigand
description: This rough-and-tumble class cuts down foes with powerful axe strikes.

name: Pugilist
description: A scrappy, gauntlet-proficient brawler. Can confuse foes with light attacks.

name: Archer
description: Facility with a bow allows this class to take down distant foes and flying units.

name: Rogue
description: A thief and expert lockpick. Can also move swiftly through forests for scouting.

name: Armored Knight
description: This class, clad in thick armor, acts as a sturdy shield for allies.

name: Light Cavalry
description: This horse rider can swiftly gallop across the battlefield.

name: Charioteer
description: Can fire a bow and charge at foes, crushing them. Cannot avoid attacks.

name: Armored Ornius Rider
description: Mounted upon an ornius, this armored class soars over obstacles.

name: Winged Soldier
description: Riding atop a pegasus, this class soars through the sky and easily resists magical attacks.

name: Shaman
description: A spellcaster specializing in black magic that pierces the heaviest of armor.

name: Priest
description: Can use white magic to heal allies and sling attacks at foes.

name: Shido
description: Highly trained and attuned to the spirit of the sword. Deals swift, fatal damage.

name: Dancer
description: With graceful, fluid dancing , this class cheers up allies, motivating them to take further action.

name: Warrior
description: Easily crushes foes with strength and well-honed axe skills.

name: Blacksmith
description: An axe wielder who can also use black magic. Quite flexible in battle.

name: Sniper
description: Able to deliver attacks from long distances. Particularly punishing to flying enemies.

name: Forest Knight
description: A knight who shoots at foes from horseback and can even navigate wooded areas.

name: Ranger
description: A skilled lockpick who moves nimbly through forests, making the class a useful scout.

name: Guardian
description: Handy with spears and white magic. Excels in both offensive and defensive fighting.

name: Dreadnought
description: Thanks to thick armor, this heavy infantry class is like a sturdy wall defending allies.

name: Bardinger
description: An elite who gallops across the battlefield with alacrity, punishing foes from horseback.

name: Cataphract
description: A heavily armored class that is talented in riding and defense.

name: Elephant Rider
description: Rides on an elephant. Attacks by charging and swinging the animal's trunk. Cannot avoid attacks.

name: Caladrius
description: Perched on an ornius. Springs over obstacles to pepper foes with black magic.

name: Dragoon
description: Flies through the sky on a bau. Is skilled in combat and has excellent mobility.

name: Ovate
description: A black-magic user who deals high amounts of damage, cutting through heavy armor.

name: Bishop
description: Draws on religious faith and the power of white magic to heal and support allies.

name: Troubadour
description: A cavalry class that can use white and black magic but not weapons. Plays spellsongs.

name: Swordmaster
description: The swordmaster has grasped the way of the blade, delivering deadly blows with blinding fury.

name: High Savant
description: Skilled with black magic as well as swords. Can kill with a single slash.

name: Battlemaster
description: A maven in the art of axe fighting. Strong, resilient, and effective on the front lines.

name: War Monk
description: Faithful and fervent. Boasts fierce power as well as the ability to use white magic.

name: Bow Adept
description: With keen accuracy, this class can take out distant foes. Specializes in downing fliers.

name: Bow Knight
description: A skilled archer and horse rider, highly mobile and able to navigate wooded areas.

name: Shadow Seeker
description: This lockpick, scout, and assassin lives in the world of shadows. The class also moves nimbly in forests.

name: Sentinel
description: A spear master who uses white magic. Excels in both combat and support roles.

name: Castle Knight
description: What this armored class lacks in agility is made up for with sheer defensive ability.

name: Orichaldia
description: A golden knight with a mastery of mounted combat, this class is one with the horse.

name: Great Knight
description: A heaviliy armored knight who rushes into the battle on horseback.

name: Celestial Trooper
description: An elite flying knight who flies on a pegasus. Is highly mobile and resistant to magic.

name: Bau Lord
description: With excellent combat skills and mobility, this class strikes fear in foes from the skies.

name: Druid
description: With mastery of a wide variety of black magic, this class can rain devastating damage on foes.

name: Wiseman
description: A sagacious class that heals and supports allies from the rear flank using white magic.

name: Valkyrium
description: Though unable to use weapons, this class can use black and white magic, as well as spellsongs.

name: The Blade
description: A protector to the gods, this class lives by the sword. There is nothing their blade cannot cut.

name: The Apsara
description: A mystic who performs sacred dances. Can soothe the hearts of the very gods.

name: The Eternal
description: A child of battle who possesses infinite power. Carves a path for the gods with an axe.

name: The Godhand
description: With a divine fist that pummels foes and heals allies, this class is a protector of the weak.

name: The Calamity
description: Sows disaster through divine will, exposing the darkness and clearing the way for better things.

name: The Trident
description: A spear wielder who pierces impure foes and uses holy magic to protect others.

name: The Cavalier
description: A swift protector who looks like a flash of lightning racing into battle.

name: The Avatar
description: A master of black and white magic. Rules over magic and mirrors the deeds of the gods.
